affected_party: organizations and agents importing portable QIF knowledge
actual_problem: attestations cannot be evaluated against explicit local issuer, identity, predicate, root, time, transparency, and revocation expectations
why_it_matters: a digest or signature can be structurally valid yet originate from an unacceptable identity, expired trust root, wrong predicate, or revoked source
why_now: vendor-neutral skills and portable agent knowledge are spreading faster than local trust policies
